title: The rational-to-constructed-real embedding is multiplicative
statement: For rationals x0, x1, CReal.ofRat(x0) * CReal.ofRat(x1) is CReal.Equiv-equivalent to CReal.ofRat(x0 * x1).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.ofRat_mul : ((x0 : Rat) -> ((x1 : Rat) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.mul (CReal.ofRat x0) (CReal.ofRat x1)) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.mul x0 x1))))

evidence.supports: CReal.ofRat_mul is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- CReal.ofRat_mul 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^CReal\.ofRat_mul[[:space:]]'
evidence.notes: `build_creal_prelude` admits CReal.ofRat_mul through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, which re-checks the proof term against the stated type, so a line in this tool's output for the exact name is a machine-checked proof having been admitted. `theorem_dependency_inventory` builds creal/complex/cpoint in one run; it exits non-zero for a named filter that matches nothing, and `grep -c` (never `-q`) independently asserts the exact tab-anchored line is present. `--release` is MANDATORY: building the constructed carriers recurses deep enough in a debug build to overflow the default thread stack (measured on this tree: release exits 0, debug SIGABRTs at 134).

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the creal prelude's trusted surface is empty, which bounds CReal.ofRat_mul
evidence.notes: `nat_axiom_inventory --include-constructed --require-axiom-free creal` builds the creal environment as its own group and reports `creal: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0` (re-measured on this tree), covering Axiom, Opaque AND Quotient, not just Declaration::Axiom -- this bounds every individual creal theorem's footprint by []. `--include-constructed` is REQUIRED: without it the command exits 1 naming `creal` as known but not built this run rather than a silent pass, which is the standing trap of an empty/absent result reading as a strong negative when the tool was never pointed at the subject. `nat_axiom_inventory` now covers `cpoint` directly (re-verified on this tree: `--require-axiom-free cpoint` exits 0 with `cpoint: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0`), so the footprint_closure_audit fallback some earlier CPoint facts used is not needed here. `--release` is MANDATORY for the same deep-recursion reason as `theorem_dependency_inventory` (measured on this tree: debug SIGABRTs at 134).
